facts.fact: Uganda's ICT minister told the ITU conference that Universal Access Fund interventions, including ICT public access centres and telecom infrastructure in underserved areas, have contributed to 96% population network coverage (GSMA, 2025).
Uganda's ICT minister said the Government has prioritised digital skills development, with more than 100,000 young people trained over the past three years.

UGA.note: No national digital strategy is stated.
No budget amount or own-resource commitment for digital stated.
No rural electricity access figure stated.
